It is a name that represents the ideal personality of a believer who is guided by Allah and derives power from Him. The name Sumrah signifies the point of perfection or the point where good and good meet. It is a name that represents the person who is committed to the service of Allah and strives to follow His will

data.cultural_impact: The name "Sumrah" holds significant cultural importance as it refers to the historic event known as the Night Journey or Isra and Mi'raj (Isra meaning journey from Mecca to Jerusalem and Mi'raj symbolizes the ascent to heaven). This night journey is considered one of the greatest stories in Islamic history and is commemorated each year during the annual Islamic holiday called Laylatul-Miraj or Night of the Ascension.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Sumrah" also holds immense spiritual significance as it represents the spiritual journey of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) towards closer union with Allah. The event of the Night Journey symbolizes the ultimate journey of self-purification and the attainment of nearness to God, conveying a message of hope, faith, and the possibility of spiritual growth for all believers.
